name: Dear Deer
source:
For the past two years, Charley managed to get a role as an actor, but as time passed by, things quickly went horribly. At first, Jeremy, Charlie's manager, seemed normal. But Charley quickly realised Jeremy had alternative motives, leading him to spiral into addiction. The need for human flesh has been eating him alive, but nobody should ever know.

Charley has no family left, everything is now up to him.

It is set in the late 70s.

[From [url=https://jelenlen.itch.io/dear-deer]itch.io[/url]]
